## 简体中文

- 服务与 UI 更新现在都会先检查已下载或上传的实际安装包，并在安装前显示当前版本到目标版本的二次确认；取消操作不会改变现有安装，刷新页面也能恢复待确认状态。
- DNS 查询记录会在上游地址前标明实际解析来源，便于区分 sing-box 核心解析与本地前置 DNS。
- 修复 Gateway 主机 DNS 接管后的系统解析恢复，并修正局域网接口选择在打开下拉框时可能被意外清空的问题。
- 改进 macOS DNS 配置恢复：网络服务被移除后不再导致恢复流程失败。
- 外部 DNS 不可达不再阻止代理核心启动；核心启动失败后每 30 秒重试，并在以太网、Wi-Fi、地址或默认网关变化时立即重试。

## English

- Service and UI updates now inspect the actual downloaded or uploaded package and show a current-to-target version confirmation before installation. Canceling leaves the existing installation unchanged, and pending confirmations survive a page refresh.
- DNS query history now labels the actual resolution source before the upstream address, distinguishing sing-box Core resolution from the local bootstrap DNS.
- Fixed system resolution restoration after Gateway host DNS takeover, and prevented the LAN interface selection from being cleared when its dropdown opens.
- Made macOS DNS restoration tolerate network services that were removed after their settings were captured.
- External DNS reachability no longer blocks proxy Core startup. Failed Core starts retry every 30 seconds and retry immediately when Ethernet, Wi-Fi, addressing, or the default gateway changes.
